title: Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.07843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. translated_title: 结合深度学习与基于可解释AI（SHAP）的多样化多特征分析的增强型MRI脑肿瘤检测
translated_abstract: 医学成像领域的最新创新显著改善了脑肿瘤的识别，超越了分辨率低、存在辐射暴露和对比度有限等缺陷的传统诊断方法。磁共振成像（MRI）因其高分辨率和无创特性，在精确、准确地刻画肿瘤特征方面发挥着关键作用。本研究探讨了多种特征表示方案之间的协同作用，包括局部二值模式（LBP）、Gabor滤波器、离散小波变换、快速傅里叶变换、卷积神经网络（CNN）和灰度行程长度矩阵，并结合五种学习算法，即k近邻、随机森林、支持向量分类器（SVC）、概率神经网络（PNN）和CNN。实证结果表明，LBP与SVC和CNN相结合获得了高特异性和准确率，使其成为一种有前景的基于MRI的肿瘤诊断方法。进一步的……
tldr: 本研究将LBP、Gabor滤波器、小波变换、CNN等多种特征表示方法与多种机器学习算法相结合用于脑肿瘤检测，发现LBP结合SVC和CNN取得了高特异性和准确率，并借助可解释AI（SHAP）对多特征分析进行了解释。
en_tdlr: This study integrates multiple feature representation schemes (LBP, Gabor filters, DWT, FFT, CNN) with various machine learning algorithms for MRI brain tumor detection, showing that LBP combined with SVC and CNN achieves high specificity and accuracy, with explainable AI (SHAP) providing interpretability for the multi-feature analysis.
